accountable-you.rationale: Every record carries its author's signature and peers reject one whose signature does not match. Authority over others is witnessed as a signed commitment that the people served can revoke.

sources.quote: designed so that no single party, including its creator, can own or control it

accountable-authors.today_note: community adoption of rule changes is designed
accountable-authors.rationale: The contributors hold no key that signs for anyone. No legal entity is named yet; licensing is an open decision the README states plainly.

sources.quote: a root LICENSE and a single policy are an open decision

affected-in-care.today_note: naming and basis rules are live; the always-reachable features are not yet enforced
affected-in-care.rationale: The identity network's rules refuse a grant with no steward or subject, a person stewarding themselves, a basis outside a fixed list, or delegation deeper than three.

sources.quote: Cannot grant stewardship to yourself

affected-named.today_note: some profile details and relationship links still sit on the public record; moving them is planned
affected-named.rationale: The canon draws the line before publication, because nothing published can be withdrawn.

sources.quote: Already-gossiped data CANNOT be recalled

decides.rationale: Validation rules ship inside each network's shared code; every peer that stores a record runs them, so a record that breaks a rule is refused everywhere.

sources.quote: Each layer can only ADD restrictions, never remove parent layer restrictions.

acts.today_note: the agent runtime is written, and no elohim takes part in any decision yet
acts.rationale: The personal constitution (act freely, ask first, never) and the human floor over any machine are constitutional canon.

sources.quote: No machine here will ever hold final authority over you that a human floor cannot overturn
no elohim takes part in any gate yet

understands.rationale: An arriving party announces who it is, for whom and why, and the person's elohim reads and explains it; the observer discloses to earn disclosure.

sources.quote: discloses to earn disclosure

privacy_loss.today_note: the five-person threshold is live; profile details are still being moved off the public record
privacy_loss.rationale: The canon's line is between thought and fruit: thoughts never enter the shared record, so the boundary sits before publication.

sources.quote: T16 aggregator enforces k-anonymity threshold before publication.
Activity ledgers are held by the holon they describe.

autonomy_loss.today_note: naming and depth limits are live; consent to a grant and deciding appeals are being built
autonomy_loss.rationale: Delegation depth and the naming rules are enforced by every peer; the appeal and the always-reachable features are declared in the identity network's code.

sources.quote: Delegation depth cannot exceed 3

security_breach.today_note: self-revocation and an emergency-contact vote run; quorum recovery is designed
security_breach.rationale: Recovery is a quorum of people who know you; cryptography accelerates community recovery paths and never becomes the sole gate.

societal_cultural_harm.rationale: The rules are published source anyone can read, copy and run, and the canon refuses to let model capability confer deference.

sources.quote: No machine here will ever hold final authority over you that a human floor cannot overturn

right_contest.today_note: filing an objection works; answering by a deadline is written as a test that fails today
right_contest.rationale: Appeal is declared inalienable in the identity network, and the protocol keeps its own claims honest by writing each one as a runnable check before it is built.

sources.quote: An objection nobody answered is reported as unanswered, never as refused

right_to_human_review.today_note: the rule is in the decision type; councils that answer are designed
right_to_human_review.rationale: Every decision has three outcomes (permit, refuse, refer to a person) and a tested law that a referral may never be converted into a refusal.

sources.quote: a collapsed refer silently swallows a question a human was owed

right_access.today_note: the functions exist; a steward can still hide an activity log, which we count as a bug
right_access.rationale: Records about you are signed records you can read on your own node, and the person in care's dashboard is declared inalienable.

right_object.rationale: Either party to a grant can revoke it; revocation is itself a signed record.

right_correction.rationale: Counter-evidence about a person is floor-protected and routed to the person it names.

available_to_3rd_parties.today_note: reach is enforced on some read paths, not yet on copying
available_to_3rd_parties.rationale: Reach (how far a record is meant to travel) is chosen when you publish; making it a gate everywhere is the work in progress.

not_available_to_vendor.rationale: The node software is open source and contains no access path for the contributors; anyone can read it to check.

data_retained.today_note: the 365-day limit is live; withdrawal requests and returning reach are designed
data_retained.rationale: The shared record is append-only, so withdrawal works by a superseding record and a returned reach rather than by erasure; the identity network's rules refuse a device policy whose log retention exceeds 365 days.

sources.quote: retention_days cannot exceed 365
Reach can be returned, an attestation withdrawn by a superseding one

shared_storage_and_governance.rationale: This element's own definition, governance enforced by policies built into the structure of the data, is how the protocol stores everything: the rules ship inside each network's code and every peer holding a share checks them.

output_about_behaviour.rationale: Publishing outcomes rather than raw data is the canon's attested-private class; some progress records still publish more than that.

mobile_notification.rationale: The storage layer reports a withheld record as refused rather than missing.

sources.quote: A withheld row is REFUSED, never reported missing

language_models.today_note: registering an AI agent in the identity network is live; attesting each layer's capabilities, and pinning the constitutional context at each gate, are designed
language_models.rationale: The identity network's rules accept an AI agent as a kind of participant beside a human and an organization, so a model is held in the same identity layer, with the same attestations, as a person.

sources.quote: "ai-agent",     // AI assistant or agent

search_retrieval.today_note: our own tooling pins algorithms by content address today; the product's search is not yet published that way
search_retrieval.rationale: Algorithms are governed artifacts: content-addressed records whose every use can pin the exact version that ran.

sources.quote: governed algorithm artifact

creates.rationale: The produce of labor is the person's; value co-created with an intelligence drawn from everyone is common inheritance, so it is cited and shared back.

sources.quote: the new value we co-create with an intelligence drawn from all of us

output_generated_content.rationale: Every record is signed by its author, so attribution of the person's part is structural; citing the commons' part is designed.

civil_liberties_harm.rationale: The counsel elohim is canon: a role with standing to defend the person on the protocol that cannot be removed while they are under pressure; plural doorways and forkable rules mean no one institution holds the off switch.

sources.quote: first-class standing to defend the human's interests on the protocol
